QuestInfo.name: Battle Prep
QuestInfo.0: #bPiston#k over in the #bCommander Barracks#k has another mission for you.
QuestInfo.1: A counterattack is imminent, and the troops need help setting up the Blue Dragon Cannon. #bCartalion#k can fill you in on the details.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Cartalion about prepping the Blue Dragon Cannon for the coming counterattack.

0.msg: The soldiers are recovering nicely now that you solved our supply problem! Who'd have thought a little protein and armor could make such a difference?\r\n

1.msg: Now for the serious missions. Have you heard of the Blue Dragon Cannon? It's an ancient weapon referenced in the Nova history book. From what we can tell, it really packs a punch!\r\n

2.msg: #b(Hmm, weapons did always interest you, but what was special about the Blue Dragon Cannon...?)#k\r\n

3.msg: Unfortunately, we've had a setback in the development process. I mean, the plans for this thing are older than dirt, so I guess there were bound to be a couple of hiccups.\r\n

4.msg: We could use your battle weapons experience to get it working. But talk to #bCartalion#k. He knows more about this than I do.\r\n

yes.0: Cartalion's already waiting for you. I'm curious about what you two will come up with.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k\r\n

no.0: You have something more important to do?\r\n

1.0: You're here! Great! Piston said you'd help out.\r\n

yes.0: You must be pretty special for HQ to trust you to help on such a top secret task as this!\r\n
yes.1: I'm honored to work with you. Give me a moment, and I'll tell you the details.

default.0: We could use your battle weapons experience to get the Blue Dragon Cannon working. But talk to #bCartalion#k. He knows more about this than I do.\r\n
